title: A hypothetical fresh HTTPS request
method: Synthetic serial intervals sum to 160 ms. Response wait contributes 90/160 = 56.25%. No overlap, pool wait, retries or proxy stages are included; values are not measured network performance.
alt: A hypothetical fresh HTTPS request. DNS: 8 milliseconds; TCP connect: 24 milliseconds; TLS: 32 milliseconds; Response wait: 90 milliseconds; Body read: 6 milliseconds. Illustrative inputs.
